environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate with Go 1.10.8 runtime container (golang:1.10.8-alpine). ALB forwards traffic directly to the container on port 8080. No WAF attached. Security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 via ALB. The ALB target group performs health checks on /health. No CloudFront distribution in front. Direct internet-facing ALB endpoint.
